description.english: Sankatahara Chaturthi is the monthly fast dedicated to Lord Ganesha, observed on the fourth day (Chaturthi) of the dark fortnight (Krishna Paksha) of every lunar month. 'Sankata' means difficulties/troubles and 'Hara' means remover — this vrat is observed to seek Ganesha's protection from all difficulties and obstacles in life.
description.hindi: संकटहरा चतुर्थी प्रत्येक माह के कृष्ण पक्ष की चतुर्थी को गणेश जी के लिए रखा जाने वाला व्रत है।
description.telugu: సంకష్టహర చతుర్థి ప్రతి మాసం కృష్ణ పక్ష చతుర్థి నాడు గణేశుని కోసం పాటించే వ్రతం.

specialMonths.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
specialMonths.note: The most auspicious — Ganesha's birthday on Shukla Chaturthi

english: Wake up early (before sunrise if possible), take a bath
Fast from sunrise to moonrise — the fast is broken only after sighting the moon at night
Perform Ganesha puja in the morning and evening
Read or listen to the Sankatahara Chaturthi Vrat Katha (story)
Break the fast after seeing the moon, offering modak as naivedya

significance.english: Observing this vrat monthly is said to protect devotees from all obstacles, grant fulfillment of desires, remove debt and poverty, bring peace in the family, and ensure auspiciousness in all new beginnings.
